reconcile.note: Matthew Henry reads Priscilla's instruction of Apollos as private household teaching, not the public church speech that 1 Corinthians 14:34-35 and 1 Timothy 2:11-12 restrict.

sides.snippet: Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained to him the way of God more accurately.
sides.verseText: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained to him the way of God more accurately.

sides.snippet: But I don't permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.
sides.verseText: But I don't permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.
